prompt: I have my money in three places and none of them are banks. The first time I lost everything I was thirty two and I thought it was something that happens once. I watched the zeros multiply on the notes, I watched them print the hundreds of billions and then the hundreds of trillions and I watched the shelves in Harare empty before the notes finished printing. The second time I was ready in the way that doesn't actually help. My son thinks I am old-fashioned because I keep cash in the house and he does not understand that cash is also not the answer, that I am just trying to find something that stays still long enough to stand on. What holds value better than currency when you have learned twice that currency is a decision someone else makes for you?
